meta: Type a description and get a picture seconds later. Inside, AI learns from lots of captioned images, practices removing grainy noise, then draws by slowly cleaning up a screen of static.
prompt: Draw ___ (subject), in ___ (setting), in a ___ style, with ___ lighting.

muc.title: How does AI draw pictures?
muc.text: Type a description, and a few seconds later you have a picture. How does AI draw it?

muc.title: Learning from lots of images
muc.text: First, AI is trained on a huge number of images, each with a description. It learns which words go with which shapes and colors.

muc.title: A strange exercise: removing noise
muc.text: The training is unusual: people sprinkle grainy noise over an image until it's nothing but static, then make AI practice removing the noise, bit by bit.

muc.title: Drawing is removing noise to match your words
muc.text: When you give a command, AI starts from a screen of static and slowly cleans it up to match your description, until the picture appears.

muc.title: A detailed description makes a better picture
muc.text: Your description is a map. The clearer the map, the less AI has to guess.

muc.title: Describe 4 things
muc.text: Describe four things: the subject, the setting, the style and the lighting.

muc.title: Write all 4, see the difference
muc.text: Open an image app and write all four. Compared to a short sentence, you'll see the difference on the first try.
